services.name: Parasail Flight
services.desc: Flight: >Premium Flight includes 1200' of towline and a "Free Fall" where the captain slows down the boat and lets you drift down toward the water, then accelerates to bring you on an "Elevator Ride" back to the top as well as a dip if you like. The boat ride is a thrill in itself as we often see dolphins, manatees and plenty of birds on our trips. Standard Flight includes 800' of towline. Rates > Premium Flight is $99 per person > Standard Flight is $89 per person > Guaranteed Observer is $50 per person Photos and SD card: $40 >We take 50-60 high resolution digital photos of your entire ride Fly solo, double or triple!
